quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Not so much X as Y' says the second idea is more accurate than the first, not that the first is entirely false.
quests.explanation: Structure: It is not so much that AI replaces workers (partial truth) + as that it quietly redefines what their work even means (fuller truth). 'Not so much...as' fine-tunes a claim rather than flatly denying it.
quests.textToSpeak: It is not so much that AI replaces workers as that it quietly redefines what their work even means.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'If there is one lesson X teaches, it is that Y' singles out the single most important takeaway.
quests.explanation: Setup (If there is one lesson the last decade of climate policy teaches) + payoff (it is that incentives beat good intentions). Builds anticipation before delivering one sharp conclusion.
quests.textToSpeak: If there is one lesson the last decade of climate policy teaches, it is that incentives beat good intentions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'For all the talk of X' means despite lots of discussion about X, little has actually changed.
quests.explanation: Concession (For all the talk of prevention) + main clause (most health budgets still flow toward treating illness after it strikes). Contrasts rhetoric with actual spending.
quests.textToSpeak: For all the talk of prevention, most health budgets still flow toward treating illness after it strikes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Nowhere is X more visible than in Y' names the clearest example of a broader tension.
quests.explanation: Claim (Nowhere is the tension between equal opportunity and unequal resources more visible) + example (than in rural classrooms). Grounds an abstract tension in one vivid setting.
quests.textToSpeak: Nowhere is the tension between equal opportunity and unequal resources more visible than in rural classrooms.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'One might reasonably ask whether X, given that Y' raises a fair doubt and immediately explains it.
quests.explanation: Question (One might reasonably ask whether a truly global culture is even possible) + reason (given how fiercely people cling to local identity). Politely introduces a challenging, open question.
quests.textToSpeak: One might reasonably ask whether a truly global culture is even possible, given how fiercely people cling to local identity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A paradox pairs two things that seem like they should move in the same direction, but don't.
quests.explanation: Framing (The paradox is that) + parallel comparison (the more efficient our tools become, the less time we somehow seem to have). 'Paradox' signals a logically surprising statement follows.
quests.textToSpeak: The paradox is that the more efficient our tools become, the less time we somehow seem to have.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The time phrase 'over the course of a generation' interrupts the verb phrase — read through it carefully.
quests.explanation: Origin (What began as a niche concern for scientists) + has become (verb, interrupted by a time phrase) + a central economic question (present state). The inserted phrase adds scale without breaking the logic.
quests.textToSpeak: What began as a niche concern for scientists has, over the course of a generation, become a central economic question.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'However one chooses to measure X' concedes that methods vary, but the conclusion doesn't.
quests.explanation: Concession (However one chooses to measure progress) + main clause (the trend toward longer, healthier lives remains genuinely unmistakable). Preempts an objection about methodology.
quests.textToSpeak: However one chooses to measure progress, the trend toward longer, healthier lives remains genuinely unmistakable.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'In hindsight' is inserted mid-sentence here, gently interrupting the main clause.
quests.explanation: It is easy (framing) + in hindsight (inserted qualifier) + to say that schools should have adapted to technology sooner (the easy claim). 'Should have adapted' expresses regret about the past.
quests.textToSpeak: It is easy, in hindsight, to say that schools should have adapted to technology sooner.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Perhaps the clearest sign of X is Y' offers a thoughtful, slightly modest claim.
quests.explanation: Subject (Perhaps the clearest sign of a healthy culture) + is (linking verb) + its willingness to laugh at itself (complement). 'Perhaps' softens a claim into a humble suggestion.
quests.textToSpeak: Perhaps the clearest sign of a healthy culture is its willingness to laugh at itself.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same fine-tuning pattern as before, now applied to a specific type of job loss.
quests.explanation: Structure: It is not so much that automation eliminates jobs (partial truth) + as that it eliminates the jobs we once considered permanent (fuller truth). Narrows exactly what kind of change is happening.
quests.textToSpeak: It is not so much that automation eliminates jobs as that it eliminates the jobs we once considered permanent.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The payoff clause offers a surprising redefinition of what 'wisdom' looks like.
quests.explanation: Setup (If there is one lesson coastal cities are learning) + payoff (it is that retreat can be wiser than resistance). Works well for a conclusion that challenges instinct.
quests.textToSpeak: If there is one lesson coastal cities are learning, it is that retreat can be wiser than resistance.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Again, big ideas in discussion are contrasted with a more ordinary reality.
quests.explanation: Concession (For all the talk of personalized medicine) + main clause (most patients still receive remarkably standardized care). Useful for questioning how much a popular idea has really changed practice.
quests.textToSpeak: For all the talk of personalized medicine, most patients still receive remarkably standardized care.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: A single, concrete example anchors an otherwise abstract complaint.
quests.explanation: Claim (Nowhere is the gap between ambition and funding more visible) + example (than in public school libraries). Turns a vague frustration into something specific and memorable.
quests.textToSpeak: Nowhere is the gap between ambition and funding more visible than in public school libraries.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The reason clause offers concrete evidence supporting the fair question raised.
quests.explanation: Question (One might reasonably ask whether globalization is retreating) + reason (given how many countries now favor local production). Grounds an open question in observable evidence.
quests.textToSpeak: One might reasonably ask whether globalization is retreating, given how many countries now favor local production.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Another paradox: more information is expected to bring more clarity, not less.
quests.explanation: Framing (The paradox is that) + parallel comparison (the more data companies collect, the less certain they seem about what it means). The irony: more input, less confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: The paradox is that the more data companies collect, the less certain they seem about what it means.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same interrupted-verb structure as before, this time spanning a decade rather than a generation.
quests.explanation: Origin (What began as isolated heat records) + has become (verb, interrupted by a time phrase) + an unmistakable pattern (present state). The shorter time span emphasizes how fast change occurred.
quests.textToSpeak: What began as isolated heat records has, over the course of a decade, become an unmistakable pattern.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The concession about measurement leads into a specific, research-based conclusion.
quests.explanation: Concession (However one chooses to measure wellbeing) + main clause (loneliness keeps emerging as an underestimated risk factor). 'Keeps emerging' suggests a finding repeated across studies.
quests.textToSpeak: However one chooses to measure wellbeing, loneliness keeps emerging as an underestimated risk factor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The same inserted 'in hindsight' pattern, now applied to a policy decision.
quests.explanation: It is easy (framing) + in hindsight (inserted qualifier) + to say that the reform should have moved more slowly (the easy claim). Gently critiques a decision while acknowledging hindsight bias.
quests.textToSpeak: It is easy, in hindsight, to say that the reform should have moved more slowly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The complement here is a whole clause: 'how easily it absorbs new words'.
quests.explanation: Subject (Perhaps the clearest sign of a language's vitality) + is (linking verb) + how easily it absorbs new words (complement clause). 'Vitality' means liveliness or capacity to thrive.
quests.textToSpeak: Perhaps the clearest sign of a language's vitality is how easily it absorbs new words.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The fine-tuning pattern applied one final time, now to a social observation.
quests.explanation: Structure: It is not so much that inequality is new (partial truth) + as that it has become harder to ignore (fuller truth). The correction shifts focus from existence to visibility.
quests.textToSpeak: It is not so much that inequality is new as that it has become harder to ignore.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Keeps repeating' suggests the lesson has had to be learned more than once.
quests.explanation: Setup (If there is one lesson this century keeps repeating) + payoff (it is that adaptation cannot wait for certainty). Implies this lesson is learned again and again, perhaps too slowly.
quests.textToSpeak: If there is one lesson this century keeps repeating, it is that adaptation cannot wait for certainty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The gap between modern discussion and everyday practice appears once more.
quests.explanation: Concession (For all the talk of digital health) + main clause (many rural clinics still rely on paper records). Draws a sharp, concrete contrast between innovation and lived reality.
quests.textToSpeak: For all the talk of digital health, many rural clinics still rely on paper records.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The example this time is a group of people, introduced with 'among'.
quests.explanation: Claim (Nowhere is the debate over automation more personal) + example (than among workers who fear replacement). 'Among' introduces a group as where a feeling is strongest.
quests.textToSpeak: Nowhere is the debate over automation more personal than among workers who fear replacement.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Tangled' vividly suggests trade relationships have become difficult to separate or fully understand.
quests.explanation: Question (One might reasonably ask whether any country still controls its own economy) + reason (given how tangled trade has become). 'Tangled' is a vivid metaphor for complex interdependence.
quests.textToSpeak: One might reasonably ask whether any country still controls its own economy, given how tangled trade has become.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The final paradox in this set: abundance leading to difficulty, not ease.
quests.explanation: Framing (The paradox is that) + parallel comparison (the more choices students have, the harder many find it to choose at all). Captures how too many options can overwhelm rather than help.
quests.textToSpeak: The paradox is that the more choices students have, the harder many find it to choose at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: 'Remarkably' is inserted for emphasis, right before the surprising verb 'outlasted'.
quests.explanation: Origin (What began as a small independent bookstore) + has outlasted (verb, interrupted by 'remarkably') + every chain that once surrounded it (object, with a nested relative clause). Adds genuine admiration.
quests.textToSpeak: What began as a small independent bookstore has, remarkably, outlasted every chain that once surrounded it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The concession about measurement leads to the sentence's final, unifying claim.
quests.explanation: Concession (However one chooses to measure success) + main clause (a livable planet remains the only measure that ultimately matters, with a nested relative clause). Brings every metric back to one shared foundation.
quests.textToSpeak: However one chooses to measure success, a livable planet remains the only measure that ultimately matters.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The passive 'should have been taken' shows the warnings were the ones needing more attention.
quests.explanation: It is easy (framing) + in hindsight (inserted qualifier) + to say that warnings should have been taken more seriously (the easy claim, passive). Expresses regret about an overlooked opportunity.
quests.textToSpeak: It is easy, in hindsight, to say that warnings should have been taken more seriously.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: The final sentence of the entire course circles back to a hopeful, forward-looking idea.
quests.explanation: Subject (Perhaps the clearest sign of genuine progress) + is that it leaves room for those who come after (complement clause, with 'who come after' as a nested relative clause). A fitting close: real progress makes space for the next generation.
quests.textToSpeak: Perhaps the clearest sign of genuine progress is that it leaves room for those who come after.
